issue.title: Bug : 'sonic-clear queue wredcounters' does not clear the wredcounters

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

Support to count and display ECN marked packets is added to -show queue wredcounter' CLI via PR -https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/pull/2807

### Steps to Reproduce

1.Run a test with  Ecn-enabled packets.
2. Verify that "show queue wredcounters <namespace>" display the counters correctly.
3. Execute "sonic-clear queue wredcounters"
4. Verify "show queue wredcounters <namespace>" and check the counters are cleared.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Currently the "sonic-clear queue wredcounters" does not clear the queue counters.

Expected:
"sonic-clear queue wredcounters" should clear the queue counters and reset the counters to 0.

resolution.title: Add multi-asic support for sonic-clear queue wredcounters and counter poll , --nonzero support for show queue wredcounters
resolution.description:
#### What I did
Added multi asic support for sonic-clear queue wredcounters to fix https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/23566
Add --nonzero support for show queue wredcounters - (https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/22674)
Added multi asic support for counterpoll commands https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/23170
The PR #4012 broke some of the sonic-mgmt tests for multi-asic since the counterpoll command was mandating the asic-ns parameter. So the existing sonic-mgmt tests which configures the counterpoll commands without ns were failing and the PR #4012 is reverted. So changing the mandatory ns attribute to optional in this PR.
#### How I did it
Modified the wredstat and counterpoll sonic-utilities script to add muti-asic support and nonzero support
#### How to verify it
Verified the clear and show commands in T2 chassis and pizza box. Also verified that the counterpoll without ns option in multi-asic systems work and configures in global ns config_db and the show command reflects this config.
